name: pqsession-relay
description: Dumb relay for pqsession end-to-end sessions: forwards opaque ciphertext only; never sees keys or plaintext. v3: Argon2id-derived room ids, connection-bound signalling, 3-message handshake with mutual key confirmation, epoch-based hybrid X25519+ML-KEM rekeying (post-compromise security), strict CSP with Trusted Types, fail-closed vendoring, PQ-hybrid TLS.

scripts.test: node csp-meta.mjs --check && node test-relay.mjs && node test-frontend.mjs && node test-e2e.mjs
